title: Concept: bcrypt work factor below the current floor in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, bcrypt is invoked with a cost factor below 12, either directly on hash or when generating a salt. The work factor sets how much computation each guess costs an attacker who has the hash database. A low value makes GPU and ASIC guessing cheap, so a leaked table of hashes falls quickly even if the passwords were reasonable.
applicability: javascript applications that store bcrypt password hashes; lexical scope.
risk: Fast offline password recovery after a hash disclosure; MEDIUM severity.
